title: 全国高等学校名单 (National list of higher education institutions), published 18 June 2026
publisher: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
license: Government information made public by the Ministry of Education
lineage: read page by page from the ministry's lookup by the Fetch institution registries workflow; English names and websites from Wikidata on an exact Chinese-name match, marked on each record
notes: in scope: every regular higher education institution (普通高等学校) on the list; adult HEIs and Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan are not on it
scope: China (mainland): every regular higher education institution on the Ministry of Education's national list of 18 June 2026: undergraduate-level institutions (本科) and vocational colleges (专科). The public directory shows the undergraduate-level ones.
manifest_notes: Announcement: http://www.moe.gov.cn/jyb_xxgk/s5743/s5744/202606/t20260618_1441074.html. The list is in Chinese and has no websites; English names and websites are from Wikidata where one item matches the exact Chinese name.
